R42|base|6.1.1.heading: REQUIREMENTS
R42|base|6.1.1.text: The lighting and signalling devices shall continue to operate correctly and to remain visible. Should the adjustment of the factory-fitted lighting devices be disturbed, it may be corrected to conform to the required specifications, provided this can be done by the normal means of adjustment. Bulbs may be replaced in the event of filament failure.

R42|base|6.1.heading: REQUIREMENTS
R42|base|6.1.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle shall meet the following requirements:

R42|base|6.1.2.heading: REQUIREMENTS
R42|base|6.1.2.text: The vehicle's bonnet (hood), boot lid (trunk lid) and doors shall be operable in the normal manner; in addition, the side doors of the vehicle shall not be able to open under the effect of the impact.

R42|base|6.1.3.heading: REQUIREMENTS
R42|base|6.1.3.text: The vehicle’s fuel and cooling systems shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning; their sealing devices and caps shall be operable in the normal manner.

R42|base|6.1.5.heading: REQUIREMENTS
R42|base|6.1.5.text: The vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment and shall operate in a normal manner. This requirement does not apply to sensors, cameras, radar devices, etc. being part of driver assist systems. They may become damaged, disoriented or broken due to an impact carried out according to Annex 3 as long as the basic braking and steering performance are still intact.

R42|base|Annex 3 1.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE
R42|base|Annex 3 1.text: SCOPE AND PURPOSE The purpose of this test is to simulate frontal and rearward lowspeed-impact conditions with another vehicle. The test shall make it possible to verify whether the protective devices of the vehicle meet the requirements of this Regulation.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE
R42|base|Annex 3 2.text: INSTALLATIONS, PROCEDURES AND MEASURING INSTRUMENTS 2.1. <u>Testing ground</u> The test area shall be large enough to accommodate the impactor (striker) propulsion system and to permit afterimpact displacement of the vehicle impacted and installation of the test equipment. The vehicle shall be placed on a horizontal and level rigid smooth surface.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.2.1.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > State of the vehicle
R42|base|Annex 3 2.2.1.text: The vehicle shall be at rest.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.2.2.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > State of the vehicle
R42|base|Annex 3 2.2.2.text: The front wheels shall be in the straight-ahead position.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.2.3.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > State of the vehicle
R42|base|Annex 3 2.2.3.text: The tyres shall be inflated to the pressure recommended by the vehicle manufacturer.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.2.4.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > State of the vehicle
R42|base|Annex 3 2.2.4.text: The brakes shall be disengaged and the transmission control shall be in neutral position.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.2.5.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > State of the vehicle
R42|base|Annex 3 2.2.5.text: Vehicles equipped with hydro pneumatic, hydraulic or pneumatic suspension or a device for automatic levelling according to load shall be tested in the normal running conditions specified by the manufacturer.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.3.1.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > Impactor (striker)
R42|base|Annex 3 2.3.1.text: The impactor shall be of rigid construction, the impact contour being of hardened steel.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.3.2.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > Impactor (striker)
R42|base|Annex 3 2.3.2.text: The impacting surface shall conform to the diagram in the figure.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.3.3.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > Impactor (striker)
R42|base|Annex 3 2.3.3.text: The effective mass shall be equal to the mass corresponding to the “unladen weight" of the vehicle to be tested.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.3.4.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > Impactor (striker)
R42|base|Annex 3 2.3.4.text: With plane A of the impactor vertical, the reference line shall be horizontal.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.3.5.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > Impactor (striker)
R42|base|Annex 3 2.3.5.text: The first contact of the impactor with the vehicle shall be by the impact contour on the protective device. In the two vehicle-loading conditions the protective device between the corners, as defined in paragraph 3.1.5. of this Regulation, shall be intersected by the horizontal plane passing through the reference line.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.4.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE
R42|base|Annex 3 2.4.text: Propulsion of the impactor The impactor may either be secured to a carriage (moving barrier) or form part of a pendulum.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.5.title: Special provisions applicable where a moving barrier is used
R42|base|Annex 3 2.5.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE
R42|base|Annex 3 2.5.text: Special provisions applicable where a moving barrier is used

R42|base|Annex 3 2.5.1.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > Special provisions applicable where a moving barrier is used
R42|base|Annex 3 2.5.1.text: If the impactor is secured to a carriage (moving barrier) by a restraining element, the latter must be rigid and be incapable of being deformed by the impact; the carriage shall at the moment of impact be capable of moving freely and no longer be subject to the action of the propelling device.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.6.title: Special provisions applicable where a pendulum is used
R42|base|Annex 3 2.6.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE
R42|base|Annex 3 2.6.text: Special provisions applicable where a pendulum is used

R42|base|Annex 3 2.6.1.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > Special provisions applicable where a pendulum is used
R42|base|Annex 3 2.6.1.text: The distance between the pivot and the centre of percussion shall be at least 3.3 m. The reference line shall coincide with the centre of percussion.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.6.2.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > Special provisions applicable where a pendulum is used
R42|base|Annex 3 2.6.2.text: Plane A of the pendulum shall remain parallel with its axis of rotation throughout the test.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.6.3.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > Special provisions applicable where a pendulum is used
R42|base|Annex 3 2.6.3.text: In the case of a parallelogram-suspended pendulum, the trajectory described by any point on the reference line shall be constant with a radius of at least 3.3 m.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.7.1.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > Longitudinal impact test
R42|base|Annex 3 2.7.1.text: This test consists of two impacts on the front surface and two impacts on the rear surface of the vehicle. On each surface one impact is made with the vehicle under "unladen weight", as defined in paragraph 3.1.3. of this Regulation, and the other is made with the vehicle under "laden test weight", as defined in paragraph 3.1.4.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.7.2.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > Longitudinal impact test
R42|base|Annex 3 2.7.2.text: For the impacts on the front and rear surfaces, the choice of location of the impactor for the first impact is free, but for the second impact the median plane of the impactor shall be at a distance at least 300 mm from the first, provided that during these impacts the extremities of the impactor do not pass outside a zone defined by two planes parallel to the longitudinal median plane and passing through the corners of the vehicle.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.7.3.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > Longitudinal impact test
R42|base|Annex 3 2.7.3.text: The impactor shown in the figure should be placed so that plane A is vertical and the reference line is horizontal at the reference height of 445 mm.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.7.4.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > Longitudinal impact test
R42|base|Annex 3 2.7.4.text: The vehicle should be aligned so that a point between the vehicle corners touches, but does not move, the impactor, the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle being perpendicular to plane A of the impactor.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.7.5.title: The vehicle should be impacted at a speed of 4 km/h +0.25/-0
R42|base|Annex 3 2.7.5.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > Longitudinal impact test
R42|base|Annex 3 2.7.5.text: The vehicle should be impacted at a speed of 4 km/h +0.25/-0

R42|base|Annex 3 2.8.1.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > Corner impact test
R42|base|Annex 3 2.8.1.text: This test consists of an impact at one front corner and an impact at one rear corner of the vehicle, which is at unladen weight (see paragraph 3.1.3. of the Regulation), and an impact at the other front corner and the other rear corner with the vehicle at the weight given in paragraph 3.1.4.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.8.2.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > Corner impact test
R42|base|Annex 3 2.8.2.text: The impactor shown in the figure should be placed so that plane A is vertical and the reference line is horizontal and at the reference height of 445 mm.

R42|base|Annex 3 2.8.3.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > Corner impact test
R42|base|Annex 3 2.8.3.text: The vehicle should be aligned so that a corner of the vehicle touches the impactor without moving it. In addition the following conditions shall be met: (a) plane A of the impactor shall make an angle of 60 ± 5º with the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle; (b) the point of the first contact shall be in the vertical median plane of the impactor (within a tolerance of ± 25 mm).

R42|base|Annex 3 2.8.4.title: The vehicle should be impacted at a speed of 2.5 km/h +0.1/-0
R42|base|Annex 3 2.8.4.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > Corner impact test
R42|base|Annex 3 2.8.4.text: The vehicle should be impacted at a speed of 2.5 km/h +0.1/-0

R42|base|Annex 3 3.title: CONDITIONS GOVERNING REPAIR, REPLACEMENT AND MEASUREMENT
R42|base|Annex 3 3.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE
R42|base|Annex 3 3.text: CONDITIONS GOVERNING REPAIR, REPLACEMENT AND MEASUREMENT

R42|base|Annex 3 3.1.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > CONDITIONS GOVERNING REPAIR, REPLACEMENT AND MEASUREMENT
R42|base|Annex 3 3.1.text: The protective devices and the mountings attaching them to the vehicle structure may be repaired or replaced between the tests.

R42|base|Annex 3 3.2.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > CONDITIONS GOVERNING REPAIR, REPLACEMENT AND MEASUREMENT
R42|base|Annex 3 3.2.text: If the protective devices include self-restoring materials, the permitted recovery time between tests shall be as stated by the manufacturer.

R42|base|Annex 3 3.3.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > CONDITIONS GOVERNING REPAIR, REPLACEMENT AND MEASUREMENT
R42|base|Annex 3 3.3.text: If the manufacturer so requests, a vehicle of the same type may be used for each test.

R42|base|Annex 3 3.4.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > CONDITIONS GOVERNING REPAIR, REPLACEMENT AND MEASUREMENT
R42|base|Annex 3 3.4.text: If the manufacturer so requests, the technical service responsible for conducting the tests may allow the same vehicle as is used for tests prescribed by other Regulations (including tests capable of affecting its structure) to be used also for the tests prescribed by this Regulation.

R42|base|Annex 3 3.5.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > CONDITIONS GOVERNING REPAIR, REPLACEMENT AND MEASUREMENT
R42|base|Annex 3 3.5.text: If the test has been carried out at an impact speed or with an impact mass exceeding those indicated in paragraphs 2.7.5. and 2.8.4. above, and the vehicle has satisfied the conditions prescribed, the test is considered satisfactory.

R42|base|Annex 3 3.6.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > CONDITIONS GOVERNING REPAIR, REPLACEMENT AND MEASUREMENT
R42|base|Annex 3 3.6.text: Measuring instruments The instrument used to record the speed referred to in paragraphs 2.7.5. and 2.8.4. above shall be accurate to within one per cent.

R42|base|Annex 3 4.1.heading: Annex 3 LOW-SPEED-IMPACT TEST PROCEDURE > EQUIVALENT TEST METHODS
R42|base|Annex 3 4.1.text: Other equivalent test methods are permitted provided that the conditions referred to in this Regulation can be observed and that their equivalence can be demonstrated. Figure - Impact device

R42|base|3.1.5.heading: DEFINITIONS > For the purpose of this Regulation,
R42|base|3.1.5.text: "Vehicle corner" means the vehicle’s point of contact with a tangent vertical plane which makes an angle of 60° with the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle;

R42|base|3.1.3.heading: DEFINITIONS > For the purpose of this Regulation,
R42|base|3.1.3.text: “Unladen weight" means the weight of the vehicle in running order, unoccupied and unladen but complete with fuel, coolant, lubricant, tools and a spare wheel (if provided as standard equipment by the vehicle manufacturer);

R42|base|3.1.4.heading: DEFINITIONS > For the purpose of this Regulation,
R42|base|3.1.4.text:
“Laden test weight" means the weight of the vehicle when it is loaded to the conditions indicated in paragraph 3.1.3. plus the weight of the passengers (taking 75 kg. per passenger) distributed as follows:
|Number of seating positions|Number of passengers|Distribution|
|---|---|---|
|2 and 3|2|2 in the front seats|
|4 and 5|3|2 in the front seats 1 in the back seat|
|6 and 7|4|2 in the front seats 2 in the rearmost seats|
|8 and 9|5|2 in the front seats 3 in the rearmost seats|
When the rear row of seats has only two seating positions, one person shall be on the second row from the rear

R42|base|8.1.heading: CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
R42|base|8.1.text: Every vehicle bearing an approval mark as prescribed under this Regulation shall conform to the vehicle type approved, particularly as regards features which influence the behaviour of the parts of the structure and the components affected by impact.
